source: Electronic Communications Privacy Act of 1986 (ECPA), Pub. L. 99-508, 100 Stat. 1848
wound_addressed: 1968 Act left cellular, email, pager, and all electronic communications unprotected; stored communications had no protection at all
design: Added 'electronic communication' to Wiretap Act; created Stored Communications Act (§§2701-2712) for stored communications; established interception vs. storage distinction
key_boundary: Wiretap Act = real-time interception during transmission; SCA = accessing stored communications after storage
